t0011-01.gloss: A runner's card keeps a personal request beside an official route.
t0011-01.rival_reading: A farm program could use an office runner for field notices; a return copy and family note do not show that containment failed.

t0011-02.gloss: An access key is attached to a page that was never filled in.
t0011-02.rival_reading: A field courier could secure a site key to a blank clipboard before a handoff; the empty page does not prove anyone was left without instructions.
